miRBioGenAtlas v2.0.2 — Multi-Consortium Pan-Cancer miRNA Biogenesis & 3D Saturation Atlas

Harmonised across 21,140 clinical & primary human tumours (10,195 TCGA PanCanAtlas + 10,945 MSK-IMPACT), 9,578 mature miRNA-seq profiles, 13.37M miRNA×mRNA couplings (9,353 dual tumours), 213,940 saturation-mutagenesis substitutions with interactive 3D wild-type vs mutated side-chain & physicochemical delta modelling (16 Cryo-EM/X-ray PDB complexes, AlphaFold v6, AlphaMissense, ESM-2 3B, ESM-1v, ESM-IF1 3D), 16,569 ClinVar clinical records, gnomAD v4 constraint, GTEx 54-tissue baselines, CPTAC proteomes (N=1,002), and DepMap CRISPR screens (N=1,208).

Cancer-Type-Stratified Log-Rank & Multivariable Breslow Cox Survival Benchmarks (TCGA-CDR & MSK-IMPACT)

Multivariable TCGA Cox models adjust simultaneously for age at diagnosis, biological sex, AJCC pathologic stage (III/IV vs I/II), hypermutator status, and cancer-type baseline hazard strata; MSK-IMPACT models adjust for metastatic specimen status, TMB hypermutator status, panel version, and cancer-type strata.
